title: Espresso Testing Guide Companion
title_es: Companion de la Guía de Espresso Testing
description: Runnable files from the Espresso guide: Gradle dependencies, a login test, a Page Object, a custom IdlingResource, a RecyclerViewMatcher helper and a GitHub Actions workflow that runs connectedAndroidTest on an emulator matrix.
description_es: Archivos ejecutables de la guía de Espresso: dependencias Gradle, un test de login, un Page Object, un IdlingResource a medida, un helper RecyclerViewMatcher y un workflow de GitHub Actions que corre connectedAndroidTest en una matriz de emuladores.
